title: Read one lawless system around our space whole: deposits, creatures, stations, order books, mission boards
note: Kept by Oracle (orders F13). Since 2026-11-15 21:50 UTC, on Suggi's word, every division and the whole command group fly it: it stands in every plan before `park`. The list: the 27 systems within two jumps of our border, nearest first, then Atlas and Intercrus, LHS 1140 beside Antares for its station (Trade, requests.log ENT-045); since 2026-11-15 23:27 UTC the third ring from our border (the 10 lawless systems of it not yet listed, from game/map/galaxy.tsv) and Goldcrest and Bluerift of the fourth, beside LHS 1140. Their Ironlight bases are outposts without services (data/station/stations.json, 23:38 UTC): no book there. Hive Antares has no market either (services: crafting, refuel at 2 cr, repair, salvage yard, storage; read 23:29 UTC). GSC-0016 lies one lane from the pirate stronghold Gliese 581 (governance/map.md, section 4). Every system on the list is lawless (police 0) and none is a stronghold. A system where a ship of ours was lost leaves the list until Military has looked at it. No goods of value in the hold on the way out: `requires.empty_hold` since 2026-11-15 23:27 UTC (orders F13). Since 2026-11-16 04:31 UTC the next ring (orders F13, block ORACLE: the list widened ring by ring): marfik, acrab, acrux, botein, deepwell, felis, gliese_876, hd_147513, rastaban, the lawless systems one lane past the listed ones, 6 or 7 jumps from home, none an empire's and none a stronghold (game/map/galaxy.tsv); the pirate stronghold Gliese 581 stays off. Why now: the herds whose drops sell (veil-rays, cinder-sylphs, halo-drifters) bound the fleet's hunting at about eight places (Military's report of 2026-11-16 03:30 UTC), and a new ring is where more of them can be found; a read costs about 150 cr (77 runs, measured).
